_provenance: Locomotion as a physics fact, not a morphology check. Distance travelled under rigid-body dynamics, with robustness across randomized starts — no single lucky pose wins. The body co-evolves with the CPG rhythm; the objective binds what a GOOD walker IS.

walls.exploded: The body MUST survive simulation. NaN position or flung to orbit is not a walker — it is a debris field. This gate catches every degenerate before it scores.
walls.degenerate: The body MUST pass the structural floor. Under-size bodies, zero-length bones, and hair-thin limbs are NOT creatures — they are exploits the last run found and this gate walls out.
walls.distance: A walker MUST travel at least 0.5 body lengths. Zero distance means the body fell over and twitched — the name is walker, not seizure. The seed quadruped already walks ~2 body lengths; this floor exists only to catch regressions.
walls.robustness: The worst restart MUST travel at least 30% of the mean. Below 0.30 means the body has a LUCKY pose, not a gait — change the start height by 2 cm and it collapses. A limit cycle is robust ~1.0; a lottery ticket is ~0.0.
walls.airborne_frac: The walker MUST stay on the ground. Above 40% airborne means it is launching itself ballistically — that is not walking, it is ricocheting. The first CPU winner was a neutron-star bristlebot; this is the physics gate that catches its successor.
walls.torso_z: Torso height MUST stay between heel and half a body height. Crawling on the ground (0.05) means it never stood up; towering above 0.60 means it is a stilt-walker, not a balanced quadruped. Both are degenerate optima the first run produced.
walls.energy: Energy per unit material MUST be bounded. 999.0 is the dead sentinel; above 200.0 means every joint is fighting every other joint — a convulsion, not a coordinated gait. The brain's job is to lower this; the body's job is to not start at seizure-level waste.
